**Event:** 80th Annual Meeting of the Academy of Management\
**Authors:** Kehr, H. M., Graff, M., & Bakaç, C.\
**Award:** Best Paper Award, Organizational Behavior Division

## Context

This paper argued that transformational leadership does not affect all followers equally:
its effects depend on the motives followers bring with them. It received the Organizational
Behavior Division's Best Paper Award.
